title: Read a hosted history page
responsibility: Read one page of source history and expose commit events with completeness metadata.

inputs.name: hubHistory.context
inputs.description: Authorized source context with repository, pinned commit, tree entries, source adapter and cache identity.

inputs.name: hubHistory.input
inputs.type: { branch?: string; paths: string[]; page?: number }
inputs.description: Paths to inspect and optional page, default 1; branch is accepted but not used.

outputs.name: hubHistory
outputs.description: Up to the requested 20-entry page as commit events sorted by authored time, with complete and nextPage from the adapter.
